description: Fixed the critical scalar initialization bug in the GPT class where `y` and `x0_lambdas` were incorrectly assigned to class variables (`self.y`, `self.x0`) instead of the forward pass parameters (`self.x`, `self.x0`) during the forward pass. This caused the MuonAdamW optimizer to fail initialization on the first step due to uninitialized tensors being passed to MLP layers, resulting in a crash and a val_bpb drop from 0.9913 to 0.9944.
